about: Everything that extension/manifest.json may ask the browser for, each with its reason. scripts/check-manifest.mjs fails when the manifest asks for more or for less: Chrome disables an installed extension after an update that asks for a new permission or host, until someone accepts the new warning in chrome://extensions, and a board display in kiosk mode then stops switching without a word. Add an entry here only with its justification in store/listing.en.md and store/listing.de.md, and a note in the changelog that the update asks for it.

permissions.storage: Keeps the saved accounts, their sessions and the settings of the button on this computer.
permissions.alarms: Renews the parked sessions in the background, so they still work days later.
permissions.scripting: Runs the extension's own content.js again in the Autodarts tabs that are open when the extension is installed or updated, so a display in kiosk mode keeps its button without a reload.

host_permissions.https://play.autodarts.com/*: The Autodarts page: content.js reads and writes the session there, shows the button of the switcher, and the worker finds the Autodarts tabs by their address with it.
host_permissions.https://api.autodarts.com/*: The sign-in service of Autodarts: renewing a session, signing in with a remembered password and ending a session.

web_accessible_resources.switcher.html: The switcher that the button lays over the Autodarts page, a page of the extension in a frame, so the scripts of the page can't read the accounts out of it.
